title: Request-cohort SLI fidelity and failover playbook
creator: Aisha Manning
description:
Summary: Build instrumentation and dashboards that measure SLI fidelity at the request-cohort level (route + tenant + sequence-length bucket + model-variant), tie that telemetry to admission + decode pipeline signals, and produce an operational playbook for progressive multi-region failover and automated circuit decisions.

Motivation: Current token-level SLIs are aggregated at high cardinality but we lack a reliable way to: 1) surface cohort-specific SLO burn, 2) correlate admit-controller decisions with tail decode latency, and 3) rehearse graceful regional failover for cohorts that show early signs of degradation. This work creates a cohesion between the admission layer, token-latency metrics, and the regional failover automation.

Scope:
- Define a "cohort-fidelity-score" SLI computed per (route, tenant, model-variant, seq-length-tier): combines p95 decode latency, admit delay p99, kv-cache hit rate, and synthetic prefix success rate.
- Instrument request path (edge -> router -> shard) to attach cohort tags and emit admit/queue/decode spans with token granularity.
- Add synthetic cohort prober that mirrors production request distributions (prefix-preserving + long-context + short-burst).
- Build Grafana dashboards: Cohort Matrix, Admit vs Decode Waterfall, Failover Rehearsal Timeline, and Cohort Burn Diagnostics.
- Author an operational playbook for progressive failover: thresholds, automated rollback, fallback model mapping, and customer-impact communication templates.

Non-goals: full rewrite of SLI pipeline; long-term storage redesign; per-subtoken quality metrics (deferred).
acceptance_criteria: Cohort tags emitted end-to-end for >= 95% of production traffic (edge, router, runtime)
Cohort-fidelity-score computed and stored in metrics DB with < 2s ingestion latency
Dashboards (Cohort Matrix, Admit vs Decode Waterfall, Failover Timeline) implemented and validated with synthetic and production traffic
Playbook contains automated threshold actions (promote fallback, increase admission slack, notify paging) and a rehearsal checklist
No more than 5% false-positive cohort failovers in 2-week canary run
tasks: Edge tagging: add cohort headers to upstream requests (PR: github.com/redwood/edgerouter/pull/4987)
Router instrumentation: emit admit_delay_ms, admission_score, queue_depth with cohort labels (PR: github.com/redwood/router/pull/5012)
Runtime spans: extend existing trace schema to include cohort_id and seq_len_tier (change set: runtime-traces#216)
Metric pipeline: update metrics extractor to aggregate cohort-fidelity-score; add a hot-path for <2s ingestion
Synthetic prober: implement prefix-preserving request generator and schedule per-region probes (config: ops/probers/cohort_preserve.yaml)
Dashboard panels: implement cohort matrix heatmap, admit vs decode waterfall, failover rehearsal timeline
Playbook: draft operational runbook and automated actions in ops/playbooks/cohort_failover.md
Canary rollout: run in prod region-us with 5% of traffic then scale to 25% following acceptance criteria
comments: 2026-03-02 - Aisha Manning: Kickoff synced with Router and Runtime leads. Router team flagged potential cardinality blowup; agreed to limit cohort dimensions to (route, tenant_tier, seq_bucket, model_family).
2026-03-04 - Liam Chen: Prototype admission header schema implemented; working through edge-router header propagation for gRPC streams. See draft PR. Waiting on tests for long-lived streams.

2026-03-06 - Observability: Metric pipeline shim added to accept cohort labels as a single joined tag to avoid high-cardinality cardinality (cautious approach). Need to confirm downstream dashboard grouping semantics.
2026-03-08 - Design review: UX requested separate matrix for 'synthetic probes' vs 'real traffic' to avoid alert bleed. Agreed to tag synthetic metrics and show toggles in dashboard.
2026-03-10 - Blocker: eBPF collection for admit_delay_ms under review (security). Security team requested scoped capability list. Filed ENG-834211 to track that work.

2026-03-11 - QA: Synthetic prober initial run produced clear cohort failures for a small tenant with long sequences; found a model-variant mapping error in fallback config. Patch submitted (github.com/redwood/ops-config/pull/76).
2026-03-12 - Liam Chen: Dashboard skeleton created in grafana (dashboard id 14072) and linked to synthetic probe stream. Next: wire production metrics and add annotation layers for failover events.
risks_and_mitigation: Cardinality explosion: mitigate by joined_tag + coarse seq length buckets and tenant_tier grouping
False positives from synthetic probes: separate synthetic tag and calibrate probe distributions against production percentiles
Security review delays for eBPF: fall back to user-space timers for admit_delay_ms collection until approval
Storage cost: keep cohort metrics at 1h rollup after 30d and only retain hot cohorts at full fidelity
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (Canary): deploy edge+router tagging and metric pipeline in us-west-2 for 5% traffic; run synthetic probes for 48h
Phase 2 (Expand): if canary stable and false-positive <5%, expand to 25% traffic and enable automated threshold alerts (pager) for high-fidelity cohorts
Phase 3 (Automate): enable automated failover actions for cohorts that cross fidelity thresholds for >5m with manual approval window
Rehearsal: schedule 1 regional failover rehearsal per quarter using synthetic probes and verify rollback procedures
